title: Jelly Roll's insecurity among Chicago musicians
summary: Austin says Jelly Roll avoided Chicago musicians because he could not read music, though he thought himself the best pianist.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Well, anyway, like you said, there weren't very many people, I guess, in New Jellie in those days.
You don't remember any other friends or musicians?
You know, he used to call himself Falona, and he figured, because he couldn't read music, and he was in Chicago. He figured they were better than he was,
and he wouldn't go around with them. Wouldn't go around with them. Sort of afraid to...
Yes, he was just like that.
He was... Yeah, he was a better musician than they were, as far as I was from the year, I guess.
But he didn't figure then. He figured he was the best piano player there was in the world, but after they left the piano, he just figured he was...
